stem: A genomic prediction model trained on a small, genetically narrow population performs well during internal fitting. What must occur before relying on it to select unrelated breeding material?
choices: Nothing; internal model fit establishes transferability
Independent validation in representative target germplasm with reliable phenotypes and relevant environments
Increase sequencing depth on the training population only
Replace phenotype records with cultivar names
rationale: Prediction accuracy must be validated in the target population and relevant environments. Strong genomic models still depend on representative training data and high-quality phenotypes.
